new.n: Tom Kelly's buried lead-mine gold, Kelly's Bluff, Dubuque
new.st: Tom Kelly, a miserly Irish lead miner, smelted his own ore from a cave on the bluff and never trusted banks. After he died (1867) his heirs dug between $4,000 and $5,000 in gold from the ground under his hut, and further caches turned up later; local tradition says much more was never found.
